title: Review event
description: One decision of one reviewer: a line of reviews/<reviewer>.jsonl. Events are append-only and never edited. Merging two reviews is the union of events by id; the current decision of a reviewer on an item is the event with the latest ts (ties: the later line) among the events with the same reviewer, unit and design. Undoing a decision appends a 'clear' event. docs/data_contract.md section 7.

type.description: Event type. Only 'decision' exists; the field is reserved for comments and votes (phase 2). Default decision.

id.description: Event id: 'ev' plus lowercase hex of a hash of (reviewer, unit, design, decision, ts, a per-session counter). Must be unique across all reviewers so a union has no clashes. Older versions wrote ev + 8 hex digits (djb2).

reviewer.description: Name the reviewer chose. Free text.

ts.description: UTC time of the decision, e.g. 2026-10-01T07:12:55Z.

unit.description: What was decided on: a backbone family (the board's default unit) or a single design.

design.description: Id of the family (campaign bb) when unit is family, or of the design when unit is design. Name kept from the earlier events.

run.description: Run id of the family or design, for convenience; null when it spans runs.

decision.description: clear removes the reviewer's earlier decision on the item.

sequences.description: Design ids put on the order list (keep decisions on a family: the chosen sequences of the family). Empty otherwise.

reasons.description: Reason keys from profile.reasons (wrong site, small interface, floppy, sticky, low confidence, pose disagrees, oligomer clash, liability, duplicate).

learning.description: Whether the reviewer model was learning from decisions when this one was made.

bundle.description: manifest bundle.id of the bundle the reviewer was looking at. Events from another bundle are kept but flagged on merge.

app.description: Writing tool and version, e.g. binderscope-viewer 0.1.0.

supersedes.description: Id of the event this one replaces (informational; the latest ts rule decides).
